title: Introduction to Tajweed: Reciting the Qur'an Correctly
description: Tajweed for beginners from the Qur'an Workshop of TROID (Toronto-based Salafi da'wah organisation): tafsir and tajwid from Juz Tabarak. Twelve weeks of guided reading that build correct recitation from the foundations of the salafi way - muddoon (lengthening), makharij (articulation points), and the rulings of the reciter.
short_description: Recite the Quran correctly: a beginner's tajweed workshop

modules.title: The Foundations of Tajweed (Juz Tabarak)
modules.description: Twelve sessions on the rules of recitation, taught through Juz 'Amma/Tabarak.
